130101.name: Luna · I
130101.desc: I was heavily injured and unconscious when Raphael found me near the mountains. She brought me back to Yume Academy and took care of me until I healed. However when I woke up the only thing I remembered was my name.

130102.name: Luna · II
130102.desc: All I have is my name: Luna. Aside from that I have no memories no belongings and no friends. There's no one here for me…I'm so lonely here.
130102.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.1

130103.name: Luna · III
130103.desc: A person called "Senpai" told me that I am no different from any other girl in the Academy. He invited me to become an official student of the Academy and even gave me a bunny!
130103.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.2

130104.name: Luna · IV
130104.desc: Senpai's name isn't Senpai and he told me his name (oﾟ▽ﾟ)o I gave him some snacks I made will he like them?
130104.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.3

130105.name: Luna · V
130105.desc: Senpai suggested that I join the Baking Club so it seems like he liked the snacks after all! The Club members are kind and children often visit us for snacks. I don't feel lonely anymore.
130105.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.4

130106.name: Luna · VI
130106.desc: A tall girl Angelica visited us for snacks today. She doesn't look like a child. Hey! Don't laugh at her Frexie even grown-ups can have a snack now and then!
130106.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.5

130107.name: Luna · VII
130107.desc: I have a feeling that someone is looking at me but when I look around the only person I find is Angelica. But it can't be her: a grown-up that likes sweets and snacks so much can't be a bad person!
130107.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.6

130201.name: Blowie · I
130201.desc: It's been an entire week since I'm here at Yume Academy and I can't take it anymore~ I like it here but not having large baths are killing me.

130202.name: Blowie · II
130202.desc: I skipped classes and explored the Academy today. This place is like a prison with no recreation facilities at all! All I want is a nice bathhouse…
130202.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.1

130203.name: Blowie · III
130203.desc: If there are no bathhouses here I'll build one myself! But it's so tiring and I want to have a nice long bath~
130203.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.2

130204.name: Blowie · IV
130204.desc: Another day of working on my dream bathhouse. The first thing to do is to dig out a foundation…wait what is that thing? A dirty oil lamp?
130204.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.3

130205.name: Blowie · V
130205.desc: I dreamed that a pretty girl emerged from the oil lamp promising me one wish. I wished for a huge bathhouse. I hope it really appears when I wake up!
130205.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.4

130206.name: Blowie · VI
130206.desc: Oh my my dream bathhouse is really there! I'll go in right away. Wait a minute where has the lamp gone?
130206.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.5

130207.name: Blowie · VII
130207.desc: There are so many new buildings in Yume Academy now! Music Venues Game Centers and is that a Casino? I wonder who has the lamp now…
130207.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.6

130301.name: Angel · I
130301.desc: I need to purify the demons! It's been three months since my arrival at the Academy but I have not purified any demons yet. I need to get a grip and start doing my job! By the way what exactly are demons again?

130302.name: Angel · II
130302.desc: I seem to be ignoring the obvious: there is a Demon House right in front of my eyes! Take this Lucifer!
130302.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.1

130303.name: Angel · III
130303.desc: Michael started an hour-long rant that just ended now. All I wanted to do was to exorcise the demons but Michael is never wrong. Am I mistaken…?
130303.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.2

130304.name: Angel · IV
130304.desc: I promised Michael to not cause any trouble but that doesn't mean I accept those of House Demon as my own. I'm definitely not working with them on this expedition…wait a minute where am I?
130304.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.3

130305.name: Angel · V
130305.desc: What a day: I got lost in the wilderness and it started raining cats and dogs. What's worse a ghost appeared in front of me. Thankfully I had some holy water with me to expel it…is that Wraith from House Demon?
130305.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.4

130306.name: Angel · VI
130306.desc: Wraith is very kind: she lead the way back to the Academy even if I was the one that hurt her. I didn't even have time to apologize properly before I fell unconscious due to a fever.
130306.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.5

130307.name: Angel · VII
130307.desc: I visited House Demon to express my thanks. I don't seem to dislike the students in House Demon as much now…
130307.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.6

130401.name: Fenrir · I
130401.desc: I dragged my beat and battered body back home after another fight with a God. Dinner was ready and Mother urged me to have some delicious roasted dragon.

130402.name: Fenrir · II
130402.desc: I am not born from Mother's womb; her child by blood has long passed away. When I was about to be killed by the Gods Mother traded her powers as the Divine Wolf for my life and took me under her wing.
130402.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.1

130403.name: Fenrir · III
130403.desc: Despite Mother's protection the Gods still sought for my life; after all I am the one destined to end the Gods' reign over the world.
130403.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.2

130404.name: Fenrir · IV
130404.desc: Fewer attempts are made on my life lately. It seems like the Gods' attention is focused on the mundane planet where the humans raged war against them. Can humans truly be worthy opponents for Gods? I can't wait to find out myself.
130404.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.3

130405.name: Fenrir · V
130405.desc: Human warriors are stronger than I expected; I had a rather satisfying battle with a green-haired knight. If even a regular human warrior has such strength I'd love to witness the power of their chief. I'm having high expectations for you Ruler of the Suns.
130405.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.4

130406.name: Fenrir · VI
130406.desc: Ruler of the Suns pfft how did you ascend to immortality from being a mere mortal? You fit the description of the prophecy even more than I do. But this is not about the prophecy; let's test our strengths against each other shouldn't we?
130406.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.5

130407.name: Fenrir · VII
130407.desc: Scorching air woke me up from the darkness. How long have I been out for…? All I can see is the huge form of Mother and the golden flames devouring the heavens. The humans have won the war.
130407.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.6

130501.name: Raphael · I
130501.desc: Medical Record 1: Ithil Team Leader of Squad 11 in Regiment Alpha underwent leg surgery today. Her calm was unmoving even when she must be feeling extreme pain. She is one of the few that doesn't need to be knocked out before surgery.

130502.name: Raphael · II
130502.desc: Medical Record 2: Three Soldiers-in-training suffered puncture wounds to the stomach. They really show no mercy in training don't they? Well tough luck: the Medical Department doesn't show any mercy too.
130502.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.1

130503.name: Raphael · III
130503.desc: Another comrade didn't make it through. She was woken forcefully by the pain during the operation and it had to be paused halfway. If only there is a method to stop the patients from feeling pain…
130503.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.2

130504.name: Raphael · IV
130504.desc: After consulting with a coworker in the Medical Department I learned about Ember Lilies a poisonous plant that paralyzes the human body. However it is fatal when taken directly.
130504.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.3

130505.name: Raphael · V
130505.desc: I acquired some seeds of the Ember Lily and tried planting them. However I can't weaken the poison for it to be safe for the human body…
130505.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.4

130506.name: Raphael · VI
130506.desc: A friend brought me some research notes about the plant; perhaps she once looked into its potential as well. It helped tremendously with my research.
130506.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.5

130507.name: Raphael · VII
130507.desc: The experiment is a success! The new anesthetic should be available for use soon. I can't wait to share the good news with my friend!
130507.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.6

130601.name: Teresa · I
130601.desc: The Father taught me everything I needed to know and I always looked up to him. However with the number of disciples dwindling he has to preach on the streets instead of in the church where he should be.

130602.name: Teresa · II
130602.desc: The few disciples we have feign devotion and break every Commandment there is when the Father isn't looking. I've seen them with my own eyes.
130602.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.1

130603.name: Teresa · III
130603.desc: I "persuaded" people to visit our church through unorthodox means. The Father seems content and I am as well for seeing him like that. The church is indeed where he belongs.
130603.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.2

130604.name: Teresa · IV
130604.desc: He was upset because he found out about what I did but all I wanted was to see him smile. He just doesn't understand…words don't hold any power but he refuses to listen…
130604.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.3

130605.name: Teresa · V
130605.desc: Why is he upset? Is it because the disciples are here due to threats and bribery instead of his precious preachings?
130605.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.4

130606.name: Teresa · VI
130606.desc: The holy text and the commandments of the Deity he believes in hold no power over the people but violence does. He finally understands but he left…
130606.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.5

130607.name: Teresa · VII
130607.desc: Some students in the Academy still preach about whatever doctrine that no one but themselves cares about. Trust me I know by experience.
130607.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.6

130701.name: Bud Elf · I
130701.desc: The season when the roses wilt immediately after they bloom has finally passed! Look at the Golden Mustard bushes aren't the flowers pretty? No Susan they cannot be used in the kitchen. Golden Mustards are roses!

130702.name: Bud Elf · II
130702.desc: Monica the newcomer looks at me weirdly but I don't care! My flower friends are the best!
130702.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.1

130703.name: Bud Elf · II
130703.desc: Hey! Stop running beside the flower fields they will be hurt if you step on them! I'm not lying they have feelings too!
130703.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.2

130704.name: Bud Elf · IV
130704.desc: I shouldn't have talked about the plants talking to those people they keep insinuating that I'm lying or out of my mind. I like Saint she doesn't do any of these things.
130704.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.3

130705.name: Bud Elf · V
130705.desc: Saint says that she believes me that plants have feelings! I'll give her a bunch of buttercups tomorrow I hope she can hear them speaking as I do!
130705.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.4

130706.name: Bud Elf · VI
130706.desc: Hehe it's okay Saint I stopped caring about how the others talk about me. I think I'm used to it now.
130706.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.5

130707.name: Bud Elf · VII
130707.desc: My strength? I'm not really sure where it came from…it makes people scared of me? I never thought about it because I'm happy as long as I can stay with my flower friends.
130707.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.6

230101.name: Vera · I
230101.desc: Senpai is sneezing again. Did he catch a cold? I knew that he can't take care of himself without me!

230102.name: Vera · II
230102.desc: I helped Senpai switch to nice thick comforters. What was he even thinking using the same thin blankets that he used in summer? No wonder he caught a cold!
230102.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.1

230103.name: Vera · III
230103.desc: The Academy is filled with sneezing students today. It's easy to catch a cold in this season. Perhaps I should start working on recipes that can help the immunity system…achoo!
230103.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.2

230104.name: Vera · IV
230104.desc: Achoo! I can't believe I caught a cold too despite always staying warm and exercising frequently. If even I caught a cold the others must be faring worse. I need to work on that recipe fast…!
230104.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.3

230105.name: Vera · V
230105.desc: I set up a small table in the Academy for my special recipe and posted announcements about it but no one came…Achoo! I feel dizzy…what's happening…?
230105.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.4

230106.name: Vera · VI
230106.desc: …Senpai? Raphael? Where am I? …Oh I had a fever and fainted? I'm so sorry for making you worry…
230106.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.5

230107.name: Vera · VII
230107.desc: Here Senpai this is a new dish that I made…wait you didn't see the announcement? So that's why no one came! I was worried that no one wanted to try my cooking.
230107.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.6

230201.name: Caitlyn · I
230201.desc: (Yawns) Chevalir? Yeah go on ahead I'll sleep in today…I stayed up late playing games last night…ZZZZ

230202.name: Caitlyn · II
230202.desc: Fully recovered! I'm staying at home today: nothing beats gaming at home! Hey what are you doing taking away my VR goggles like that?!
230202.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.1

230203.name: Caitlyn · III
230203.desc: Wait a minute I thought the Academy was for girls only? What's a boy like you doing here? Besides why are you in my room?? Oh I missed the Opening Ceremony?
230203.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.2

230204.name: Caitlyn · IV
230204.desc: I seem to recall a similar scene from the dating sim I'm playing right now where the protagonist is the only boy in an all-girls school. What did the students call him again…Master?
230204.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.3

230205.name: Caitlyn · V
230205.desc: Nope I'm not going out there. Besides no dating sim protagonist orders the heroine to leave her room. It just doesn't happen!
230205.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.4

230206.name: Caitlyn · VI
230206.desc: Master didn't visit me today. It's his loss I'll finish this game without him. I can't wait to see what will happen to the girl who refused to leave her room…wait that's the end??
230206.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.5

230207.name: Caitlyn · VII
230207.desc: Yo isn't it Senpai? I've started a new game and I'm cosplaying as the bikini-wearing heroine who shoots down zombies at the beach now so I'm not calling you Master anymore. Or do you still want to be called Master?
230207.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.6

230301.name: Boxer · I
230301.desc: Nice boxing gloves! Sapphire knows me so well. She might say that she doesn't like me but I know that she cares about me deeply.

230302.name: Boxer · II
230302.desc: More students are infected by Chaos now. I must double my training so I can protect Sapphire Geisha and Miya from the infected!
230302.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.1

230303.name: Boxer · III
230303.desc: Why is Sapphire hurt? She wasn't supposed to fight! She should have hidden somewhere safe with the others while I fought outside!
230303.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.2

230304.name: Boxer · IV
230304.desc: Why did you do this KongMing? Sapphire's hands are for playing musical instruments not for holding weapons. You must have tricked her to fight for the Discipline Committee!!
230304.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.3

230305.name: Boxer · V
230305.desc: You can save your breath I don't care or want to hear your pathetic excuses. If you have the guts to face me meet me on the roof after class today!
230305.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.4

230306.name: Boxer · VI
230306.desc: S-Sapphire? Shouldn't you be resting in the Infirmary…no of course we're not fighting right KongMing?
230306.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.5

230307.name: Boxer · VII
230307.desc: Ouch ouch ouch that hurts. Raphael can you try being more gentle? Thanks…No Sapphire I don't mean that you hit hard or anything. This is nothing but a scratch…ouch…
230307.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.6

230401.name: Nobunaga · I
230401.desc: Bullied kids flock to me like chicks to a mother hen. I don't know why they act like this but I won't let them down.

230402.name: Nobunaga · II
230402.desc: The adults look down upon me because I'm not the model student that they wanted. They try to stop the kids from following my lead but to no avail. The kids make their own decisions and they have decided to stay with me.
230402.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.1

230403.name: Nobunaga · III
230403.desc: I am known as being idiotic violent absolutely-out-of-my-mind what else? What they say about me doesn't affect me at all; I know what I should do with my life.
230403.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.2

230404.name: Nobunaga · IV
230404.desc: Interesting someone dares to challenge my authority. They can have the title of King if they want it: King or not my followers chose to follow me with their own will not due to a useless title.
230404.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.3

230405.name: Nobunaga · V
230405.desc: My sister seems to be envious of my reputation. However I have no plans of sharing my position with her even if she is close to me personally.
230405.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.4

230406.name: Nobunaga · VI
230406.desc: It's time to assert my authority and position as the only rightful leader of House Monster. I will prove that I am more than a mindless simpleton.
230406.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.5

230407.name: Nobunaga · VII
230407.desc: There are few people that you can truly trust in your life; everyone will end up betraying you even the most loyal of subordinates. The fire in Honnoji Temple destroyed any trust I had in others.
230407.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.6

230501.name: Diana · I
230501.desc: The winter sun shines brightly at noon. I promised my sister an outdoor picnic today in the grassy fields…she loved nature.

230502.name: Diana · II
230502.desc: The lights dimmed and ominous violet fumes lurked on the landscape. We ended the picnic prematurely and my sister wasn't happy with this.
230502.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.1

230503.name: Diana · III
230503.desc: Everyone in town noticed the change in weather but no one knew the reason. My sister trailed sullenly behind me as we made our way back complaining that I don't keep my promises.
230503.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.2

230504.name: Diana · IV
230504.desc: The purple mist formed into a huge claw destroying houses and uprooting trees. My neighbors struggled but were eventually sucked into the void.
230504.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.3

230505.name: Diana · V
230505.desc: I ran. When I looked back I couldn't find my sister anywhere. Where was my sister? …Where am I?
230505.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.4

230506.name: Diana · VI
230506.desc: I forgot something important. It's like something was ripped out of my chest but I couldn't quite put a finger on what it was. I felt lost…and anguished.
230506.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.5

230507.name: Diana · VII
230507.desc: The sun and the moon were meant to be together: I thrive under the moonlight but only the sunlight can comfort me. I can't live without one or the other.
230507.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.6

230601.name: Sakura · I
230601.desc: A girl asked me: "Do you feel sorrowful when the cherry blossoms wither and fall?" I felt that she was referring to my name Sakura and she seemed to imply that my fate shares that of the cherry blossoms.

230602.name: Sakura · II
230602.desc: She apologized profusely when she realized how offensive the question was. She didn't have to; I didn't take it to heart. If I am destined to live like the short-lived flower then all I need to do is to make sure I live my life to the fullest before I pass away.
230602.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.1

230603.name: Sakura · III
230603.desc: The petals of the cherry blossoms fall like rain and I am enchanted by the sight. Unfortunately most fail to appreciate the beauty of the withering flowers and focus only on the blooming blossoms.
230603.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.2

230604.name: Sakura · IV
230604.desc: People often take me as a fickle person due to my love for cherry blossoms. I understand neither their logic behind this nor their audacity of making assumptions about people that they don't really know.
230604.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.3

230605.name: Sakura · V
230605.desc: I was training with my sword under the cherry blossom trees when the petals began to fall. I didn't want to hurt the blossoms so I stopped.
230605.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.4

230606.name: Sakura · VI
230606.desc: When watching the petals I found out that they fall rhythmically like notes in music. I can't help but dance to the "music" they play.
230606.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.5

230607.name: Sakura · VII
230607.desc: I felt sudden bouts of joy and sadness when dancing. When I came back to my senses I found that I was surrounded by other students watching me. How embarrassing…
230607.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.6

230701.name: Hottie · I
230701.desc: Graduate from Yume Academy? Why should I when there are so many cute girls on campus that I can still teach?

230702.name: Hottie · II
230702.desc: Saint seems to be one of those more rebellious students. Unfortunately for her she's just my type~
230702.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.1

230703.name: Hottie · III
230703.desc: Oooh look at how prettily she blushes with my "Ribbon of Lust"! Where has her cold and aloof expression gone hmm?
230703.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.2

230704.name: Hottie · IV
230704.desc: I hope she won't skip my classes next time; I'd like to believe that I have built a good rapport with her now.
230704.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.3

230705.name: Hottie · V
230705.desc: Nobunaga you're one of those students too aren't you? You're putting on a brave face but your voice is trembling…I suppose you need some "private lessons" from me too~
230705.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.4

230706.name: Hottie · VI
230706.desc: I try my best to help my students grow into their better selves with my "Ribbon of Lust"…are you ready?
230706.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.5

230707.name: Hottie · VII
230707.desc: I always feel great after chatting with my students. However when I am all alone in my dorms and reminiscing the time spent with them…I start to feel lonely.
230707.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.6

320803.desc: Obtained part of the rewards for your Defeat in Skirmish V.

330101.name: Robbie · I
330101.desc: Why didn't anyone believe me when all that I said was the truth? I got reprimanded for telling them what I saw... No please please don't throw me in the storeroom again...

330102.name: Robbie · II
330102.desc: Uncle finally forgave me and promised not to shut me in the storeroom after I apologized to everyone and said that I "lied" to them. Do the adults not like it when I speak the truth...?
330102.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.1

330103.name: Robbie · III
330103.desc: A girl was missing and everyone is looking for her. I saw her leave with a stranger last night but should I tell them?
330103.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.2

330104.name: Robbie · IV
330104.desc: If I do should I speak the truth or not? Which answer would make them happy? I don't know what to do... Oh! If I don't say anything I won't be saying something wrong. I should do that.
330104.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.3

330105.name: Robbie · V
330105.desc: Nobody scolded me this time... As long as I keep silent everything will be fine...
330105.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.4

330106.name: Robbie · VI
330106.desc: "What is your name? You seem to be the perfect pilot of the new mecha I built what with these unusually potent spiritual powers of yours. Do you want a new friend?" Robbie doesn't speak... Robbie doesn't need friends...
330106.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.5

330107.name: Robbie · VII
330107.desc: "I see... One just can't escape from the foolish no matter where they are can they? You don't have to worry: Erina is an AI not a human so nothing bad will happen if you talk to her." Erina...?
330107.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 1" reaches Lv.6

330201.name: Yuri · I
330201.desc: What am I? I am Yuri. What is Yuri? Um... Oh! I look exactly like mushrooms so I must be a mushroom too!

330202.name: Yuri · II
330202.desc: Mushrooms can't run around so neither should I but I'm so hungry... Why can't I feed on mud like other mushrooms? What's wrong with me?
330202.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.1

330203.name: Yuri · III
330203.desc: I can't take the hunger anymore... This must be the cafeteria for humans! I'll sneak in for some snacks. I must make sure the humans don't find me or they'll make mushroom soup with me!
330203.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.2

330204.name: Yuri · IV
330204.desc: Wah I got caught! Look I'm all pretty and colorful right? Pretty and colorful mushrooms like me are poisonous so you can't eat me!
330204.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.3

330205.name: Yuri · V
330205.desc: Lavia is so nice. She didn't eat me and even shared her food with me! Lemme see this is... grilled... mushrooms??
330205.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.4

330206.name: Yuri · VI
330206.desc: Mushrooms shouldn't eat other mushrooms this is cannibalism... What? I am not actually a mushroom? But I look exactly like one... Well if I am not actually one then I can eat them! Yum grilled mushrooms...
330206.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.5

330207.name: Yuri · VII
330207.desc: I will take care of the mushroom farms from now on and make sure the mushrooms grow healthy and strong! I am Yuri the Girl who knows the most about mushrooms!
330207.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 2" reaches Lv.6

330301.name: Skye · I
330301.desc: I want to stand but there are no strength left in me to do so... Every inhale fills my nose with the odor of flames rust and smoke. My life is ending here but I haven't smelled the scent of peace yet...

330302.name: Skye · II
330302.desc: "Do you want to live?" ...Who are you? Are you one of the Demons? I refuse to speak with those that find glee in causing disasters and war.
330302.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.1

330303.name: Skye · III
330303.desc: "Nope not a Demon. However I do want to use you in my experiment. What do you say? You'll get to live and I'll get a new test subject."
330303.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.2

330304.name: Skye · IV
330304.desc: Alright... If this broken and battered body can still contribute to peace there is no price that I wouldn't pay. I'll leave everything to you.
330304.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.3

330305.name: Skye · V
330305.desc: Ouch ouch ouch!! Sivney maybe ease up a bit? ... Should you stop with the experiment? No don't stop... I can take the pain. Please proceed with whatever you were doing!
330305.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.4

330306.name: Skye · VI
330306.desc: I am flying! Wind rushes through my veins and I am one with the wind... No I am faster and stronger than any gust of wind in the world. With the changes to my body I can finally put a stop to every dispute and conflict there is!
330306.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.5

330307.name: Skye · VII
330307.desc: To Yume Academy? But war still rages on in this region... No I should trust Sivney's judgement. I will set out soon.
330307.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 3" reaches Lv.6

330401.name: Hermes · I
330401.desc: These capitalists enriched themselves in the invasion of Chaos. No matter in war or peace it is always the poor that suffers. Is there something I can do for them?

330402.name: Hermes · II
330402.desc: That shameless old geezer invited me to meet him for a drink in his seaside villa and discuss what else he can do to exploit this "invaluable chance for business". Why should I be surprised? After all he wouldn't have become a millionaire had he not done the same in the past.
330402.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.1

330403.name: Hermes · III
330403.desc: He had a cruel smile on his face when I rejected his offer and said that I will soon "see the error of my ways" and will eventually "see the light". What a disgusting man! I will never gather my wealth at the expense of dead people unlike him.
330403.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.2

330404.name: Hermes · IV
330404.desc: The Mayor informed me that enemy troops will soon reach the southern borders and asked whether I would like to leave with him to seek refuge in the country to the east... but what will happen to the civilians who have no knowledge of this yet?
330404.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.3

330405.name: Hermes · V
330405.desc: I tried to spread word regarding the oncoming assault but the Mayor and the old businessmen keep foiling my efforts...
330405.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.4

330406.name: Hermes · VI
330406.desc: It seems like the wealth I have amassed isn't enough against the corruption of this city... What should I do now? Think Hermes think!
330406.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.5

330407.name: Hermes · VII
330407.desc: I hate it but I had no choice but to return to the old geezer just as he said. I swear that I will devote everything I have to make things right for this city and its people soon.
330407.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 4" reaches Lv.6

330501.name: Blair · I
330501.desc: Another day another job. The target this time is the head of a medicine company... What's his name again? It doesn't matter; after all he will be a dead man after tonight.

330502.name: Blair · II
330502.desc: He seems to know that he deserved his death since the painkillers he manufactured took away lives instead of the pain. Although what he did is none of my business vile creatures like him repulses me.
330502.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.1

330503.name: Blair · III
330503.desc: It's been a while since I started to live with her. She always told me who to kill as if that's all I am good at... Am I nothing but a killing machine to her?
330503.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.2

330504.name: Blair · IV
330504.desc: She is gentle and kind to me but at times she makes me feel worthless. She said that only ones who work diligently and follows every order of hers is worthy of her love.
330504.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.3

330505.name: Blair · V
330505.desc: Blood splatters onto my face and I can't breathe. She praises me after every successful job but the hole in my chest becomes wider with every life that I took.
330505.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.4

330506.name: Blair · VI
330506.desc: She abandoned me because I "accidentally" let an important target escape. I don't know what has gotten into me; I could have killed him easily but why didn't I?!
330506.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.5

330507.name: Blair · VII
330507.desc: What's wrong with me? If the only I am good at is killing people why can't I do it now? Please can anyone help me? Can anyone please tell me what else I can do now aside from killing people?
330507.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 5" reaches Lv.6

330601.name: Librarian · I
330601.desc: I've been visiting the Library every day lately. While my need for knowledge is satisfied but I feel cramped and sore for sitting way too long. I should get out and exercise.

330602.name: Librarian · II
330602.desc: I've read many other books after finishing "Steppenwolf" but I can't help but think of the ending of that novel everyday.
330602.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.1

330603.name: Librarian · III
330603.desc: I often feel connected to the author in my subconsciousness as if I can experience his life through his words and no longer feel alone.
330603.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.2

330604.name: Librarian · IV
330604.desc: Sometimes the words feel oddly accurate and resonates with me. I feel embarrassed as if the author has seen right through me despite we have never met.
330604.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.3

330605.name: Librarian · V
330605.desc: I discussed a question that I couldn't figure out with Valeera today and she said with a smile that I will understand it in time. She has experienced the War against the Chaos and probably knows more than I do. I should listen to her advice and wait patiently until the answer comes to me.
330605.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.4

330606.name: Librarian · VI
330606.desc: Teresa's invitation for me to join a party came out of nowhere. I hesitated when I was about the reject her offer... There are more things in life than reading all day in the Library isn't it?
330606.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.5

330607.name: Librarian · VII
330607.desc: The party bustled with people and activity and there were friendly faces everywhere. Teresa's toast was very moving and everyone raised their glasses... But I don't feel at ease here unlike the Library.
330607.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 6" reaches Lv.6

330701.name: Mika · I
330701.desc: Aquaris training with her sword reminds me of myself when I trained with my instructor. I was young and hopeful back then until everything changed several years later.

330702.name: Mika · II
330702.desc: Aquaris was a fast learner and the speed at which she mastered the moves surpassed my expectations. She always asks the reason that caused me to stop wielding a sword. Will she still trust me if she learns about my past?
330702.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.1

330703.name: Mika · III
330703.desc: It's getting colder and the earth dries up faster these days. Prime time to craft clay dolls has passed... And maybe I should finally allow myself to rest.
330703.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.2

330704.name: Mika · IV
330704.desc: ... I'm sorry... I'm sorry! ...Ah yet another nightmare. How much longer will the disaster plague my dreams? Should I atone for my sins until my last breath?
330704.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.3

330705.name: Mika · V
330705.desc: Teresa seems to be worried for me for reasons unknown and often looks at me like there was something she would like to talk to me about. When she watches the clay dolls I make I feel like she has seen right through me.
330705.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.4

330706.name: Mika · VI
330706.desc: Teresa invited me for a drink saying that one can forget everything through the wineglass. I don't understand... What past terrors does Teresa who lives life to the fullest have to escape from?
330706.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.5

330707.name: Mika · VII
330707.desc: To be honest it felt good to forget even for a small while. But when the drunkenness faded I was overcame with guilt: how could I be at peace when the knowledge that someone died because of me weighs on my consciousness? I'm sorry Teresa but I don't think I will ever join you for a drink again...
330707.unlock_desc: Unlock after "Encounter Card Upgrade · 7" reaches Lv.6

text.TIME_CLOISTER_HELP01: 1. You can get rewards by Observing in Echoes of Time.|2. 1 World of Time will be available by default where you can send your Girls to start Observing in the World of Time.|3. The total power of the Girls you send will be transferred into “Courage” “Charisma” and “Knowledge” attributes in this Observation.|4. In the World of Time your Observation Length will depend on the number of “Clockwork of Memory”. When Observation begins you will obtain the maximum “Clockwork of Memory” where 1 “Clockwork of Memory” will be consumed every 6 minutes.|5. You can speed up reading by consuming “Time Essence” however the time sped up will still consume the corresponding number of “Clockwork of Memory”. You are able to obtain “Time Essence” by passing the Stages or completing the achievements in Echoes of Time.|6. You can increase the Observation progress by completing the Achievements in the World of time. Once the Observation progress of a World of Time reaches 85%% you will be able to unlock the next World of Time.|7. There're multiple stages available in each World of Time you can unlock the stages by upgrading corresponding technologies in the Planetarium when Observing in the corresponding World of Time.
text.TIME_CLOISTER_HELP02: 1. During your Observation in Echoes of Time every 5 minutes of reading will trigger a random card. Supply Cards Challenge Cards or Encounter Cards can be triggered each type of card has a different effect.|2. When a Supply Card is triggered you will be able to receive corresponding rewards mentioned on the card after the reading is over.|3. When a Challenge Card is triggered you will enter a special battle. Your power in the battle is related to your “Courage” “Charisma” and “Knowledge” attributes. The 3 attributes mentioned provided by your own Outfit and Planetarium upgrades will be displayed in black the attribute boost provided by the Girls you dispatch will be displayed in green.|4. You will be awarded randomly according to the battle results in Challenge Cards a losing reward will be less than a winning reward.|5. When an Encounter Card is triggered there will be no instant effect but you will be able to complete some corresponding achievements by triggering Encounter Cards.|6. The Observation will end once you run out of “Clockwork of Memory” or can be ended manually. You will therefore also need to manually end your progress and claim your rewards of this Observation.|7. During the ending phase you will be able to claim the Observation rewards and the system will conclude your achievement progress. You will also be graded according to the Cards you triggered during this Observation and earn a certain amount of "Time Shards" to upgrade technologies of the corresponding World of Time in Planetarium.
text.TIME_CLOISTER_HELP03: 1. You will get "Time Shards" for this World of Time after completing Observations in this World of Time.|2. There're 2 types of technologies for this World of Time but both of them would need you to consume "Time Shards" to upgrade some of the technologies will need to be unlocked by meeting certain requirements before you can upgrade them.|3. If you upgrade technology during an Observation it will take effect starting from the next Observation.
text.TIME_CLOISTER_HELP04: 1. There're 11 Stages in each World of Time. The first 10 Stages are normal Stages the 11th Stages are special Stages. You will consume 1 "Temporal Chip" for each challenge attempt.|2. The enemy in each Stage has  “Courage” “Charisma” and “Knowledge” attributes your corresponding attributes are provided by your Outfits and Planetarium technologies.|3. The detailed effect of the 3 attributes mentioned in rule no.2 can be seen in the help text of Outfit feature.|4. After passing first each normal Stage you will get a Stage Pass reward.|5. The enemy in special Stages cannot be actually defeated. Your damage dealt in each challenge attempt will be recorded and the highest damage you deal in a challenge attempt will be used to compete with other players on a ranking board that will conclude a result and issue you rewards according to your position in the ranking board at 0:00 (UTC/GMT 0) every Friday.|6. You can only participate the ranking of 2 World of Times that are unlocked the most recently.
